description: Read the status of a film started with soclo_video_make, using the original generationId (or the exact approved projectId and revision). Same free read as soclo_video_poll. Free and read-only: it works even on connections without the filming permission and never films or charges. Keep reading (it costs nothing) until the status is terminal (ready/delivered/complete, or failed/refused); filming takes minutes, so poll rather than assume failure. It returns one Open finished film link and its immutable Library/hash/byte identity once the film is ready.

generationId.description: The original generationId returned by soclo_video_make. Recovery can instead use the exact approved projectId and revision; no newer revision is selected.

projectId.description: The approved projectId from soclo_quote. With revision, finds the film when the generationId is not held.

quoteId.description: The original quoteId from soclo_quote; preserve it when known.

revision.description: The approved revision from soclo_quote. Never substitute a newer revision.

name: soclo_video_status
title: Read a filming job status (free)
